notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hi! We fixed some bugs that was found by you and another one patch is coming soon. Check "One of the best!" and similar achievements (you have to complete any level to get missing achievements (even the level that was completed before)).
Thansk for reporting and help in bug fixes!

notes.title: Some more updates from Foxi
notes.notes:
1) Added a button to exit the game in the level menu (not only from main menu).

2) Now scroll wheel works in the Gallery.

3) The camera in the game scrolls with the mouse wheel.

4) Character gallery scrolls from any position on the screen.

5) The bug with obtaining the achievement “One of the best” (Passage of 95 levels with a score of at least 2 stars) probably was fixed.

6) Now limited moves indicators (spheres on top of the characters) will display properly on people characters and characters with hats etc.

[h1]A little later, we gonna add a super cool camera which you can rotate as you like.[/h1]

notes.title: Belated update from Foxi
notes.notes:
[b]Hello friends![/b] ːsteamhappyː

[b]This time we fixed small bugs:[/b]
1) The game now remembers the size of the window mode.

2) Fixed the tool counter. The "Undo" is still infinite.

3) The best result - our minimum number of moves without the use of tools is now indicated at each level (in some levels you can beat this number and get better result than we did, but you have to try hard ːsteammockingː). Also, we added indication of the perfect level pass-through (The stars will be green and you can see the indication on the level selection screen).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34603576/3fecd69c0a31bc65ac0de598182f6d312f8c167c.png[/img]

4) At level 34 there is a cycle of arrows, moving to them leads to infinite loop (it was not an obvious loss). Now on this section the character will stop after a certain number of moves.

I would like to add a few words about [u][b]"Teleports without number"[/b][/u]. This is not a bug, it was intended. I am an artist, I will not change it ːsteammockingː

[b]We want to apologize for being lost for a while and not fixing these minor bugs. Now we are working hard on the mobile version of this game and the development of new levels.[/b]

[b][u]A small spoiler for new chips:[/u][/b]
There will be two new elements. [u][b]Laser [/b][/u](as we promised before), and [u][b]Pusher[/b][/u]. You will learn more about what it is and how it works in new levels. [u][b]New levels are coming soon and they gonna have a new enviroment look sutable for them.[/b][/u]

[h1]We are sorry because of such a pause in development. We are (hopefully) guys and gonna become better with your help.[/h1]

notes.title: Global update from Foxy
notes.notes:
[h1]Dear friends, we changed a lot of things in this update while trying to remove mobile origin of the game.[/h1]

[u][b]Major changes[/b][/u]
We removed purchases and chests along with a currency. How do we gonna get tools and characters? It’s easy! Now on each level you gonna get 5 pieces of each bonus items. The ‘Undo’ bonus is now infinite on each level. The characters will be opening after completion of certain levels (not each level).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34603576/fb94d74d7e8d76b59aad992342d23d9832003121.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34603576/1304cfd36441ffdcabd3ced901712c530705a835.png[/img]

[u][b]Small changes and fixes[/b][/u]
Camera should save it’s position on the level properly. 
Added scroll with mouse wheel on the levels selector.

[u][b]Improved graphics[/b][/u]
Removed achievements related to chest opening (they now make no sense)
Those who were facing issue with achievements, please try to complete any level, or repeat elevator achievement. It should now complete properly.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34603576/edc99c520e4d1b28cedfe809446b8e118e779fd8.png[/img]

[h1]We are always trying to improve the game and would like to see your reviews and feedback. Thanks for playing.[/h1]

notes.title: A slight improvement in the game from Foxy
notes.notes:
Friends, hi again, it's your developers with the next update.
This time we changed the [u][b]sounds and music options behaviour[/b][/u], now you can control the volume in the game more precisely.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34603576/e4c2dca06b1167b4b40607a4b3245e0a05d91f34.png[/img]

Another nice bonus for you is the [u][b]windowed/fullscreen button[/b][/u]. Go to windowed mode and play hiding from your boss! :)

[h1]We always keep working on the game and now we need your advice![/h1]
Many of you have noticed that in some places mobile origin of the game was noticeable. ːsteamfacepalmː This is true! But we are doing our best to change this asap!

[h1]No more shopping![/h1]
In the future update, we think to exclude the store and chests. At each level, you will be getting the certain number of tools, and the characters will open automatically as you progress through the game. What say about this option? Feel free to offer your ideas, they help us a lot!

p.s. Achievements may have been fixed, but we are not sure ːsteammockingː

notes.title: Foxy decided to make update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34603576/8f8766205e46b6f7c184fe771c98e4eb35e1f7f6.png[/img]

Hello my friend! The game has a new useful feature! [b][u]New window with information about the Max turns count to get the certain amount of stars on the level.[/u][/b] Now you are able to see in advance how many movements are to be done and find out your best result at this level.
